previews.heading: Model Previews
previews.subtitle: Control background preview generation for the whole instance.
previews.infoScope: This only affects the small 3D thumbnail shown on model cards (Models, Collections) — never the full model viewer. It also only applies to files with no thumbnail yet: an embedded thumbnail from a sliced .3mf file, or one already generated before, is always reused automatically regardless of this setting. This choice only decides what happens for the rest — typically .stl/.obj files, or a .3mf with no embedded thumbnail:
previews.infoAutomatic: Automatic — a visitor's browser renders and saves the missing thumbnail as soon as its card scrolls into view.
previews.infoOnDemand: On demand — a card shows a "Generate preview" button instead; nothing renders until someone clicks it.
previews.infoDisabled: Disabled — cards always show a placeholder; a thumbnail is never rendered.
previews.automaticDesc: Load missing previews only as cards enter view, then save them for future visits.
previews.onDemandDesc: Show saved previews immediately and generate missing ones only when requested.
previews.disabledDesc: Never generate card previews. Interactive viewing remains available by opening a model.

thingiverse.heading: Thingiverse Access Token
thingiverse.subtitle: Instance-wide credential for the official Thingiverse Developer API -- shared by every user's Thingiverse imports, not a per-user setting.
thingiverse.helpText: Create an app at thingiverse.com/apps/create (any type, e.g. "Desktop") and paste the Access Token it shows you. This is different from your Thingiverse login -- it's a permanent token tied to the registered app.

thingiverse.tokenPlaceholder: Paste a new token to replace the current one
thingiverse.tokenHelperConfigured: For security, the current token is never shown again -- leave this blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.

database.helpText: Host and port always reflect the DATABASE_URL this instance was started with and can't be changed here. Database, user, and password can be switched live — the new credentials are tested before anything is applied, so a typo can't take the app down, but the switch only affects this running process and won't survive a restart.

database.confirmWarning: This repoints every database call this running instance makes at a different database. If the new credentials are wrong or unreachable, the switch is rejected and nothing changes.
